metadata.title: Remarks on the Brascamp--Lieb inequality
metadata.abstract: We prove several variants of the Brascamp--Lieb inequality which are adapted to additional symmetries, weights, and non-Euclidean radial structures. First, an improved Brascamp--Lieb inequality for even functions yields a strengthened Prékopa--Leindler theorem for even strongly log-concave functions. We also record a Legendre-transform proof of a generalized log-Sobolev inequality for log-concave functions. Further results include a Brascamp--Lieb inequality with a concave weight, an unconditional second-order Poincaré inequality, a rotation-trick improvement for arbitrary even log-concave measures, and a Poincaré-type inequality associated with smooth norms.
metadata.comment: 42 pages, the majority of the paper written before spring 2026

analysis.progressType: 函数不等式的对称与加权改进
analysis.workSummary: 证明适应对称性、权和非 Euclidean 径向结构的 Brascamp–Lieb 变体：偶函数改进推出偶强对数凹函数的加强 Prékopa–Leindler 定理；用 Legendre 变换证明对数凹函数广义 log-Sobolev 不等式；另得凹权 Brascamp–Lieb、无条件对称二阶 Poincaré、偶对数凹测度的旋转技巧改进及光滑范数相关 Poincaré 型估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 系统展示对称及权结构如何增强经典函数不等式，提供可迁移的分析工具。
analysis.limitations: 各变体分别要求偶性、强对数凹性、无条件对称、凹权或范数光滑性，不能合并成任意测度下同时成立的增强结论；摘要未给出全部常数及等号条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者称主体数学内容与初稿历时数年由作者完成，例外是 Remarks 5.2、5.3；编辑时 ChatGPT-5.6 pro 用于查数学及排版错误、改善写作、补详论证，并提出第五节的潜在应用，由作者选入两条 remarks。标写作、证明展开、核验及应用探索；没有把主体定理的核心路线归于 AI，故不标核心 ideas。第 4、6、7 页的近期 AI 突破讨论和第 42 页 OpenAI 文献本身不构成本篇使用披露，阳性依据为第 9 页声明。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.34289v1 · PDF 第 9 页，AI use statement
